hero.slogan: Created for difference. Made for everyone.
hero.description: AI-first platform for learning, originally designed to support people with developmental differences, adapting to any thinking style.

problem.title: Problem
problem.point2: Special learners are excluded or forced to fit norms
problem.point3: EdTech doesn't use AI's full potential as a teacher

solution.title: Solution
solution.point1: CortexTutorAI is an AI-mentor adapting to cognitive profile, emotions, mistakes, and mimicry
solution.point2: Learning becomes truly personalized from scratch

path1.title: I learn like everyone / I want to grow faster
path1.point1: Platform helps improve learning, memory, analysis skills

path2.title: I learn differently / I have a unique learning style
path2.point1: Support for ASD, ADHD, dyslexia, anxiety, neurodiversity
path2.point2: No pressure. No failures. Respect for your style.

how.title: How does CortexTutorAI work?
how.step1: The platform analyzes your thinking style and emotions via tests and facial expressions
how.step2: AI selects individual methods, pace, and learning format
how.step3: You learn with real-time support and feedback

whynow.title: Why now?
whynow.point1: AI and neurotech now enable mass personalized learning for the first time
whynow.point2: Demand for inclusion and neurodiversity support is growing worldwide
whynow.point3: Investors seek projects with social mission and scalable market

traction.title: Our achievements and social impact
traction.metric1: > 10,000 users with developmental differences tested the platform
traction.metric2: 95% report increased motivation and learning confidence
traction.metric3: Partnerships with top universities and inclusive schools

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: For everyone who wants to learn more effectively: both for people with developmental differences and the general audience.
faq.a2: AI analyzes your thinking style, emotions, and mistakes to select the optimal learning path.
faq.q3: Is the platform free to use?
faq.a3: Yes, basic features are free. For advanced options — subscription or grants.
